# Hugo Martins, PhD

> Hugo Martins is an AI literacy educator and Lecturer at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore, specialising in higher-education curriculum, assessment and responsible human–AI work.

- https://hugomartins.eu/teaching — teaching philosophy, capability model, methods and evidence
- https://hugomartins.eu/teaching/ai-literacy-ntu — CC0007 AI literacy teaching case in NTU’s Interdisciplinary Core Curriculum
